articles.title: Over 11,000 people evacuated ahead of missile test in Odisha's Candipur
articles.summary: Ahead of a scheduled DRDO missile test in Balasore, Odisha, the district administration temporarily evacuated 11,442 residents from 11 hamlets. These villages were located within a 3.5-km radius of the test site, a standard precautionary measure to ensure public safety during such defence trials. This operation highlights the meticulous planning and coordination involved in India's ongoing indigenous missile development programs.

articles.title: India's SatSure bags $2.6 million grant to build AI-powered Earth observation models
articles.summary: Indian space startup SatSure Analytics recently secured a ₹246 million ($2.57 million) grant from the nation's space regulator. This significant funding is dedicated to developing advanced Artificial Intelligence models for Earth observation. The initiative underscores India's burgeoning private sector role in space technology and its commitment to leveraging AI for crucial geospatial data analysis, promising enhanced capabilities across various sectors.
